title: Scalar cup agrees with ordinary module cup
statement: For any scheme over a field, scalarCohomologyCup of two classes equals an ordinary module cup characterized by IsModuleCupProduct.

proof.text: The proof is the compatible injective-resolution comparison described in the declaration docstring: identify scalar Ext classes with module resolution cycles via evaluation at the unit, compare pullback or signed tensor pairing, and transport through the canonical cohomology comparison maps. Resolution independence removes choices.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj G →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
        (@id X.Modules (F ⊗ G)))
    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct F G p q cup)
    (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology f G q) :
    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q a b = cup a b
